_leia: Inglês. Cartões gerados em inglês (dep-N-en.webp), com nomes e textos inventados.

depoimentos.alt: Message from Mariana S.: “I left the session with a lighter head. For the first time I understood where this urge of mine to please everyone comes from.”
Message from Rosa M.: “I relaxed so much I dozed off at the end 😅 Thank you for the care and for the audio afterwards, I listened twice.”
Message from Thiago R.: “I listened to the feedback calmly on the bus. I wrote down three things to bring to our next conversation.”
Message from Patrícia L.: “I thought online wouldn't work for me. It did. I felt heard, with no rush at all.”
Message from Carla F.: “Three months later, I notice I pause before reacting on impulse. It may seem small, but to me it's a lot.”
Message from Denise A.: “I liked not having to talk much. It was time just for me, something rare in my week.”
